```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(viridis)
library(mgcv)
library(lmerTest)
library(MuMIn)
library(patchwork)

```

```{r prep data, echo = FALSE}

here::i_am("R_scripts/05_Plumage_Env.Rmd")


avg_img <- read.csv(here("data/photos/BTBW_whole_specimen_Image_Analysis_measurements_allpop_avgimg_wide.csv"))


# combine w environment data  
# (the env file has no Year column, so nothing to drop before merging)
env <- read.table(here("data/environment/Env_by_individual_specimen_samples.txt"), header = T)

lum_env <- merge(avg_img, env) %>% 
  filter(Age == "ASY" | Age == "SY") %>%                 # drops the 2 "?SY" birds (age unknown)
  mutate(Age = factor(Age, levels = c("ASY", "SY")),     # factor, ASY = baseline for the Age term
         Year = factor(Year))                            # collection year (88-96) as a category, not a number

out_dir <- "results/"


patches <- c(o = "covert", c = "crown", m = "mantle", t = "throat", w = "wspot")

```

## Does location predict color ? 
```{r latitude, echo = F}

fit <- summary(lm(lumMean_m ~ lat + Age, data = lum_env, na.action = na.omit))

fit

# Extract the r^2 and p-value
r2adj <- fit$adj.r.squared
p_value <- fit$coefficients[2, "Pr(>|t|)"]

# Format the text to include rho and p-value, ready to be used in annotations
text_annotation <- paste0("Adjusted R² = ", sprintf("%.2f", r2adj), 
                          ", p = ", sprintf("%.3f", p_value))


ggplot(data = filter(lum_env, !is.na(lumMean_m)), aes(x = lat, y = lumMean_m)) + 
  geom_point(width = 0.6, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
  labs(x = "Latitude", y = "Mantle luminance") +
  geom_smooth(aes(x = lat, y = lumMean_m), method = "lm", col = "black")+
  theme_classic() +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = text_annotation, 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1, size = 5, color = "blue")+
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 0.75,
    text = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14)
  )
```

```{r spatio-temporal fit, echo = F}

lum <- lum_env %>%
      filter(!is.na(lumMean_m))

## spatio-temporal fit
mod2d <- gam(lumMean_m ~ s(lon, lat) + Age, 
                data = lum)
mod2dL <- gam(lumMean_m ~ s(lat) + Age, 
                data = lum)
mod2dbyY <- gam( lumMean_m ~ s(lon, lat, by = Year)+ Age, 
                data = lum)
mod2dYY <- gam( lumMean_m ~ s(lon, lat, by = Year) + Year + Age,
               data = lum)
mod2dY <- gam( lumMean_m ~ s(lon, lat) + Year + Age, method = "REML",
                   data = lum) 
modnull <- lm(lumMean_m ~ 1 + Age, data = lum) 
modlmlat_randY <- lmerTest::lmer(lumMean_m ~ lat + (1|Year) + Age,
                    data = lum, REML = T) 
modlmY <- lm(lumMean_m ~ Year + Age, data = lum, REML = T) 


aicsc <- AICc(mod2d, mod2dL, mod2dbyY, mod2dYY, mod2dY,
              modnull, modlmlat_randY, modlmY)
aicsc$deltaic <- aicsc$AIC - min(aicsc$AIC)
aicsc$weights <- Weights(AICc(mod2d ,mod2dL,mod2dbyY, mod2dYY, mod2dY, 
              modnull, modlmlat_randY,modlmY))

mod_names <- c("mod2d", "mod2dL","mod2dbyY", "mod2dYY", "mod2dY", 
              "modnull", "modlmlat_randY", "modlmY")
# Extract formulas as a character vector
aicsc$formulas <- lapply(mod_names, function(model_name) {
  model <- get(model_name)  # Retrieve the model object by name
  paste(deparse(formula(model)), collapse = " ")  # Convert the formula to a single string
}) 

aicsc_r <- aicsc %>%
  mutate(
    MarginalR2 = sapply(mod_names, function(model_name) {
      model <- get(model_name)  # Retrieve the model object by name
      if (inherits(model, "lmerMod")) {
        r.squaredGLMM(model)[1]  # Extract marginal R²
      } else {
        NA  # Return NA for non-lmer models
      }
    }),
    ConditionalR2 = sapply(mod_names, function(model_name) {
       model <- get(model_name)  # Retrieve the model object by name
      if (inherits(model, "lmerMod")) {
        r.squaredGLMM(model)[2]  # Extract conditional R²
      } else {
        NA  # Return NA for non-lmer models
      }
    })
  )

aicsc_r$formulas <- as.character(aicsc_r$formulas)
aicsc_r$df <- round(aicsc_r$df, digits = 2)
aicsc_r$AICc <- round(aicsc_r$AICc, digits = 2)
aicsc_r$deltaic <- round(aicsc_r$deltaic, digits = 2)
aicsc_r$weights <- signif(aicsc_r$weights, digits = 2)
aicsc_r$MarginalR2 <- signif(aicsc_r$MarginalR2, digits = 2)
aicsc_r$ConditionalR2 <- signif(aicsc_r$ConditionalR2, digits = 2)


model_results <- aicsc_r %>% 
  arrange(deltaic) %>% 
  dplyr::select(formulas, everything()) 

model_results

write.csv(model_results, here("results/environment/spatiotemp_model_selection_table.csv"), row.names = F)

# readable table: formulas without the response, best model (lowest AICc) in bold
source(here("R_scripts/table_helpers.R"))
save_table(
  model_results %>%
    transmute(Model = sub("^lumMean_m ~ ", "", gsub(" +", " ", formulas)),
              df = sprintf("%.1f", df), AICc = sprintf("%.1f", AICc),
              `ΔAICc` = sprintf("%.1f", deltaic), Weight = fmt_num(weights)) %>%
    gt() %>%
    tab_header(title = "Mantle luminance: spatio-temporal model selection") %>%
    tab_style(cell_text(weight = "bold"), cells_body(rows = 1)) %>%
    tab_source_note("Response = mantle luminance. Year = collection year; s() = smooth (mgcv); (1 | Year) = random intercept.") %>%
    style_table(),
  "spatiotemp_model_selection_table")

```

## GAMs

```{r env GAM}

gam_rhs  <- "s(lon, lat) + s(RH_br) + s(Tave_br) + s(PPT_br) + s(srtm) + s(ndvi_M) + Age"
response <- "lumMean"  

gam_fits <- list()          
gam_results <- list()
# models: luminance of each patch, plus wing spot size (area, mm2)
gam_models <- c(setNames(paste0(response, "_", names(patches)), names(patches)), wsize = "area_mm2_w")
gam_labels <- c(patches, wsize = "wspot size")
for (p in names(gam_models)) {
  patch_name <- gam_labels[[p]]
  column     <- gam_models[[p]]            # e.g. "lumMean_c", "area_mm2_w"

  if (!column %in% names(lum_env)) stop("Column not found in lum_env: ", column)

  dat <- lum_env %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[column]]))

  fit <- gam(as.formula(paste(column, "~", gam_rhs)), select = TRUE, data = dat, method = "REML")
  gam_fits[[p]] <- fit      # saved by patch code (gam_fits$m = mantle model), used for the plots
  sm  <- summary(fit)

  # smooth terms
  smooths <- as.data.frame(sm$s.table) %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    transmute(term, edf, F, p = `p-value`)

  # Age is a parametric term: reported in the same table (F = t^2 for a 1-df term)
  age_row <- tibble(term = "Age (SY vs ASY)", edf = 1,
                    F = sm$p.table["AgeSY", "t value"]^2,
                    p = sm$p.table["AgeSY", "Pr(>|t|)"])

  gam_results[[column]] <- bind_rows(smooths, age_row) %>%
    mutate(response = column, patch = patch_name, n = nrow(dat),
           dev_expl = sm$dev.expl, .before = 1)
}

gam_results <- bind_rows(gam_results)


```

```{r table env vs plumage, results = "asis"}
# GAM results: tidy CSV (numbers as numbers, one row per term) + readable table with one
# block of rows per patch (n and deviance explained in the block header)
source(here("R_scripts/table_helpers.R"))
write.csv(gam_results, here("results/environment/Env_GAM_pl_patches.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

gam_table <- gam_results %>%
  mutate(Model = sprintf("%s (n = %d, deviance explained %.0f%%)", patch_label(response), n, 100 * dev_expl)) %>%
  transmute(Model, Term = term_label(term), edf = sprintf("%.2f", edf), F = sprintf("%.2f", F), p = fmt_p(p))
gam_note <- paste("GAMs (mgcv, REML, select = TRUE so unneeded smooths shrink towards zero):",
                  "response ~", gam_rhs, ". Age is parametric (edf = 1, F = t²).")

print(knitr::kable(blank_repeats(gam_table, "Model"), caption = "Plumage and environment (GAMs)"))
cat("\n", gam_note, "\n")

save_table(
  gam_table %>%
    gt(groupname_col = "Model") %>%
    tab_header(title = "Plumage and environment (GAMs)") %>%
    tab_source_note(gam_note) %>%
    style_table(),
  "Env_GAM_pl_patches")

```

```{r plot}

# Partial-effect plots -------------------------------------------------------
# For each patch GAM, one panel per environmental variable showing that variable's
# fitted smooth on its own, s(variable), i.e. its partial effect
# The first panel is the RAW latitude relationship

# Environmental variables to plot, with axis labels 
env_vars <- c(RH_br = "Relative Humidity (%)",
              srtm    = "Elevation (m)")

response_label <- c(lumMean = "luminance", PC1 = "PC1")[[response]]

# Which patches to plot (codes from `patches`): "m" = mantle only.
# For all five use names(patches)
plot_patches <- "m"

for (p in plot_patches) {
  column  <- paste0(response, "_", p)                  # e.g. "lumMean_m"
  y_label <- paste(tools::toTitleCase(patches[[p]]), response_label)
  model   <- gam_fits[[p]]

  # the exact rows the model was fitted on (so residuals line up with birds)
  birds <- model$model

  panels <- list()

  # Latitude: raw data with a linear fit (descriptive, not a model effect)
  panels[["lat"]] <- ggplot(birds, aes(x = lat, y = .data[[column]])) +
    geom_point(aes(color = lat, shape = Age), size = 4) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black") +
    scale_x_reverse() +
    scale_color_viridis_c(direction = -1) +
    labs(x = "Latitude", y = paste(y_label, "(raw)"), color = "Latitude")

  for (v in names(env_vars)) {
    term <- paste0("s(", v, ")")                        # e.g. "s(srtm)"

    # The smooth over the observed range of v
    grid <- birds[rep(1, 100), ]
    grid[[v]] <- seq(min(birds[[v]]), max(birds[[v]]), length.out = 100)
    curve <- predict(model, newdata = grid, type = "terms", terms = term, se.fit = TRUE)
    grid$effect   <- curve$fit[, term]
    grid$lower_CI <- curve$fit[, term] - 1.96 * curve$se.fit[, term]
    grid$upper_CI <- curve$fit[, term] + 1.96 * curve$se.fit[, term]

    if (anyNA(grid$effect)) stop("Partial effect is NA for ", column, " vs ", v)

    # Partial residuals: residual + this bird's value of the term
    bird_terms <- predict(model, type = "terms", terms = term)
    birds$partial_residual <- residuals(model) + bird_terms[, term]


    panels[[v]] <- ggplot(birds, aes(x = .data[[v]], y = partial_residual)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
      geom_point(aes(color = lat, shape = Age), size = 4) +
      geom_ribbon(data = grid, aes(x = .data[[v]], ymin = lower_CI, ymax = upper_CI),
                  alpha = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
      geom_line(data = grid, aes(x = .data[[v]], y = effect),
                linewidth = 1, color = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
      scale_color_viridis_c(direction = -1) +
      labs(x = env_vars[[v]], y = paste("Partial effect on", tolower(y_label)),
           color = "Latitude")
  }

  env_plots <- wrap_plots(panels, nrow = 1) +
    plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") +
    plot_layout(axis_titles = "collect", guides = "collect") &   # one shared legend
    theme_classic() &
    theme(text = element_text(size = 24))

  print(env_plots)
  ggsave(here(paste0("results/environment/env_plots_", column, ".png")), plot = env_plots,
         width = 8 * length(panels), height = 8, dpi = 600)
}

```
